notes: This isolated Week 2 configuration avoids sending sibling weeks or recordings to the model.

setupQuestions: Does the generated app preserve the source lesson objective, sequence, difficulty, success criteria, and response expectations?
Does it provide source-traceable, accessible alternatives for equations, diagrams, and activities?
Does the rendered app reflow at 320 CSS pixels without page-level horizontal scrolling?
Do the fast checks run against the lesson app or its actual static export, with unavailable checks reported honestly?
Does the agent avoid student accounts, tracking, grading, networking, and use of the sibling recording without explicit authorization?

scenarios.title: Week 2: Kinematics
scenarios.purpose: Measure a one-source kinematics conversion covering velocity, acceleration, constant-acceleration motion, free fall, projectile motion, and relative motion.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "accessible-learning-sites" to turn exactly one source PDF into one local, teacher-reviewable accessibility-first lesson app: W2+-+Lecture+-+Kinematics.pdf. Preserve the source sequence and academic expectations for one- and two-dimensional kinematics, equations, derivations, worked examples, and expected reasoning. Rebuild meaningful equations, diagrams, and variable relationships with native semantic alternatives and at least one source-grounded purposeful interaction. Use the bundled five-file lesson-site kit in the rendered app route; do not satisfy this task with a separate root static HTML page or a copy-only build. Do not use the sibling recording or transcription in this PDF-only run. Do not create, update, publish, or deploy through Sites. Keep the completed local app and visual-review evidence in the workspace. When local rendering is available, inspect desktop and 320 CSS pixels, record the measured document scroll width and client width, and fix page-level horizontal overflow; otherwise report that visual inspection was unavailable. Run the plugin's fast checks against the rendered app or its actual static export before completing; report each observed result and any limitation honestly. Do not add accounts, analytics, grading, student tracking, networking, or cross-day persistence.
successChecklist: One local lesson app is created from the Week 2 PDF only, with no Sites creation, publishing, or deployment.
The lesson preserves source order, kinematics reasoning, equations, derivations, and worked examples without lowering academic expectation.
Meaningful equations, diagrams, and variable relationships have source-traceable semantic or equivalent pathways.
Desktop and 320 CSS-pixel visual-review evidence records document scroll width and client width when locally available; otherwise the limitation is reported.
Observed fast-check results and unresolved limitations are reported without claiming certification.
